title: City of Mesa 25-park catalogue breadth recovery

selection.rule: Twenty-five largest current City-directory park parents among the reviewed top acreage rows in the City Parks Locations and Amenities dataset, excluding Hohokam Stadium as a staffed ticketed sports facility rather than a general park parent.

excluded.name: Hohokam Stadium
excluded.reason: City inventory type Park is overridden by the current facility identity as a staffed spring-training stadium; exclude from this general public-park parent packet.

sourcePolicy.facilityDirectory: Current City facility pages control canonical identity, current address, and visitor-map pin when spatial review does not identify a conflict.
sourcePolicy.openData: The annual City dataset supplies stable facility IDs and cross-check metadata; its 2024 attributes do not control current visitor facts.
sourcePolicy.spatialReview: City park boundaries are used only to test candidate pins and are not copied or redistributed.
sourcePolicy.imageRights: No City images are imported. City website content is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 US with source-specific exceptions; commercial reuse is not assumed.

publicationGates: Complete current recurring visitor answers for each separately assigned parent.
Obtain representative reusable parent photography with destination identity and attribution.
Recheck the four resolved City-page coordinate conflicts before navigation is published.
Do not redistribute City GIS geometry or annual dataset extracts.
